rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The statement dated 30 July 1998 says the Hashimoto cabinet resigned en masse that day (橋本内閣は、本日、総辞職いたしました) and that, taking the upper-house election result seriously, he decided to resign the office of Prime Minister (総理の職を辞することといたしました).
